observations: Photo 0: a large floor-standing office multifunction copier-printer in black and white, standing in a dusty warehouse among other used copiers.
Photo 0: front panel badge reads 'bizhub PRO C754e' with a colour accent mark; 'KONICA MINOLTA' logo on the upper front.
Photo 0: document feeder on top, a touch screen control panel on the right, screen dark and not showing any menu or counter.
Photo 0: four numbered paper trays (2, 3, 4 visible, plus the main drawers) in the base.
Photo 0: plastic wrapping stuffed into the output area under the scanner, and a loose cable hanging down the front.
Photo 0: a printed sticker label on the right front panel, too small to read.
Photo 0: 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' watermarks across the image.
Photo 0: no photo of the machine powered on, no meter or page count, no test print.

read_from: photo 0 front panel badge 'bizhub PRO C754e'

claims.evidence: Photo 0 front badge reads 'bizhub PRO C754e' and the Konica Minolta logo is on the front.

claims.claim: Large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a floor-standing machine with scanner, document feeder and multiple trays; the C in the model and the colour mark on the badge mark it as a colour model.
Photo 0 shows the screen dark; no power-on, copy or print clip.

risks.risk: The machine does not power on, or prints with faults, or shows error codes.
risks.proof: A clip of the machine powered on, making a colour copy from the feeder, showing the printed page.

risks.risk: Very high page count, so the drums, fuser and transfer belt are near the end of life.
risks.proof: A photo of the screen showing the total counter or the meter report printout.
risks.if_unproven: as high mileage needing drums and fuser

risks.risk: Internal parts missing, such as toner units, drum units, fuser or the output tray; the plastic wrap hides the output area.
risks.proof: Photos with the front doors open showing all four toner cartridges and drum units in place, and the output area uncovered.

risks.risk: Machine is a stripped shell from a used-copier yard rather than the unit offered.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial plate at the back next to a handwritten code with today's date.
risks.if_unproven: priced but flagged; no money moves before the agent sees it run

proof_requests: A clip of the machine powered on making a colour copy, with the printed page shown.
A photo of the total counter on the screen or a printed meter report.
Photos with the front doors open showing toner and drum units, and the output area unwrapped.
A photo of the serial plate with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
response.reason: Brand and model are read off the front badge in photo 0, so it can be priced as a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e at its worst case, not working and for parts. Proof that it powers on, prints and has a known page count would raise it.
